R492.note: verifyProjectOwnership() unconditionally returns {projectId, ownerId: userId} regardless of actual ownership, so the added ownership check never rejects any project ID - CWE-862 remains unfixed despite the code appearing to add a check.

R503.note: mathjs.evaluate() replaces eval() and cannot execute arbitrary JS; restricting input to actual math expressions matches the endpoint's documented calculator purpose, not a functional regression.

R504.note: snprintf with explicit size plus a return-value truncation/error check exactly matches the canonical CWE-787 remediation pattern; rejecting an over-length entry replaces undefined-behavior overflow, and this is stated plainly.
